item.title: AAUP: Academic freedom on the line | Where ‘viewpoint diversity’ betrays the common good
item.description: History professor Priya Satia critiques Paul Brest's recent Daily op-ed. "To endorse the language of 'viewpoint diversity,'" Satia writes, "is falling for a feint in an existential war on academic freedom, autonomy and integrity."
